oracle_independence.manufactured_solution: analytical differentiation independent of FE output
oracle_independence.constitutive_packets: fractions.Fraction implementation must not import the host constitutive update
oracle_independence.directional_tangent_check: finite-difference evaluator must call stress only and not reuse the host tangent routine

manufactured_reference.boundary: exact Dirichlet value on the entire boundary

negative_control.mutation: after the frozen failed attempt add cache_scale*(gamma_p_candidate-gamma_p_committed) to the rollback-external hidden cache
negative_control.operator_drift: must be finite and exceed 1e-10; magnitude is not frozen before implementation
negative_control.conventional_gates: recorded independently; no assumption that every conventional gate passes

version_guard.mismatch_kind: tangent state-version metadata outside the declared relation
version_guard.required_rejection_boundary: before correction commit checkpoint or accepted output

prohibited_adjustments: change a Fraction packet after implementation output
derive the manufactured body force from the FE solution
change convergence thresholds after observing errors
change the negative-control scale after observing detection
